item.title: Review: My husband has such bad breath we haven’t kissed in years – but he won’t see a dentist | Ask Annalisa Barbieri
item.description: You clearly love him, but do you love yourself enough to stop letting him get away with this? I’ ve got a very upsetting problem in my marriage: my husband has extremely bad breath. We have been together for 20 years and it has always been noticeable, but has got worse in recent years. Recently, he lost a tooth, which he said he knocked out, but I’m pretty certain it fell out due to gum disease. I have spoken to him about this issue in the past, and even managed to get him to the dentist once, but he became so frightened that he ran out of the surgery. Since then, whenever I mention his breath or the dentist, he becomes very defensive. Continue reading...

item.title: Review: Hacks, AI and conspiracy theories: why are we having so many outages?
item.description: After chaos at airlines, banks and companies from Microsoft to Apple, people have become convinced the world’s systems are under attack Nicole Reindorf’s American Airlines flight was ready for takeoff in Phoenix when the pilot came on the intercom and announced what was to become the longest nationwide aviation shutdown since 9/11 . Reindorf, 70, had seen the headlines hours before about a global Microsoft outage . She immediately suspected the two were linked in some way by AI-related threats – and that she would not get to the wedding of her best friend’s son in California. Continue reading...
